testimonials.author: Z & M Sparrow

testimonials.quote:
When we decided to custom design and build our retirement home we had several objectives in mind. After a succession of very typical suburban styled homes in the city we very much wanted to explore modern architecture and designs that feature very large open spaces and expansive vistas that would allow us to enjoy our beautiful natural forest and rocky lakeside setting all year long. While modern architecture was definitely our objective it was also very important for us to incorporate natural materials such as granite and wood products that would blend so well with our property. We wanted a design that optimized day to day living for a couple but would also easily accommodate visiting family and guests offering all privacy and well appointed accommodations.

Working with Adam, Timberline's in-house architect, we were able to translate our objectives and wish list into a beautiful custom home that met every requirement we had set. As a retired couple and with years of pent-up ambition to build a home we knew we'd be very active with the builder during the design and building process. Timberline was very facilitating with this approach. Fortunately, we also had the perfect pilot project for our planned home — a new Bunkie to be built on our property in the style of our eventual home. Building the Bunkie first gave us the opportunity to use it as a test bed for design elements and materials that we hoped to eventually use in our home and it also afforded us the opportunity to be onsite during the entire building process. This was a huge help for us.

One of the big advantages that Timberline brought to the table, in addition to their in-house design capability, their large and experienced construction staff and their strong trade and supplier relationships is their in-house excavating and landscaping services company — Northey Contracting. They handled everything from site servicing and preparations to final hardscaping services utilizing rocks uncovered on our own property during construction. Timberline helped us realize our goal to build a beautiful modern home within our naturally forested and rocky lakeside property.
testimonials.author: W Smith

testimonials.quote: Ray, Dave, John, Heather, Riley, and the entire team at Timberline — I just want to express my sincere thanks and appreciation for all you and the rest of the team and subs have done to get us back to our cottage. It has been a stressful year since the fire and you all have been so professional and accommodating. It was amazing to walk in on Friday afternoon and see the transformation that has been made. faqs.question: What area do you build in?
faqs.answer:
Timberline is located and primarily builds in the Kawartha Lakes region of Ontario, Canada. We typically provide our services surrounding Apsley, Buckhorn, Lakefield, Bridgenorth, Peterborough, Havelock, Norwood, Burleigh Falls and Woodview.

Common lakes where you can see our projects along the shoreline include: Jacks Lake, Koshabog Lake, Big Cedar Lake, Julian Lake, Eels Lake, Lovesick Lake, Anstruther Lake, Chandos Lake, Buckhorn Lake, Loon Lake, Belmont Lake, Chemong Lake, Rice Lake, Mississauga Lake, Gold Lake, Kathewanooka Lake, Catchacoma Lake, and notably Stoney Lake. While we generally build in these areas, we are not limited to them and may expand our range.

faqs.question: What type of home is a Timberline Custom Home?
faqs.answer: Timberline builds more than just homes — we design and build custom homes, cottages, renovations, additions, boathouses, garages, bunkies, docks, and more, of all sizes. Each project is completely custom to your personal needs and requests. We provide our own expertise to help design your ultimate dream project, in any style and any size. If you're already working with an architect, we'd be delighted to work with them as well. Timberline accentuates the timber look throughout the majority of our projects, incorporating real timbers combined with false beam work across the interior and exterior. While the timber work isn't always structural, the result carries the same desired appearance.

faqs.question: Is a Timberline home expensive?
faqs.answer: We pride ourselves on delivering the best quality-built custom projects with top-notch service. We keep value for money in mind as we help guide your finishing choices, and you'll find our pricing fair. If you build with Timberline, you'll receive a detailed contract outlining each stage of the build. Cost depends on many variables — you control your final cost through the products and materials you choose. It's easy to go over budget; our team helps you stay within budget while still achieving your desired look. Timberline has no hidden fees — we pride ourselves on honesty and integrity. Let us prove it to you.

faqs.question: What is your price per square foot?
faqs.answer: We don't provide an upfront price per square foot, as it can be misleading. Every Timberline project is custom and requires individual consideration. Because of this, an initial consultation is important to understand your tastes and lifestyle needs — after which you'll receive a rough estimate. A final design is needed before we can provide a final price.

faqs.question: At what point do I have to pay any money?
faqs.answer: Timberline's initial consultation is always free — you're welcome to visit our office, or we can visit your potential building site to discuss your ideas and vision. If you'd like us to proceed with a rough design sketch, a small fee applies, based on the size of your project.

faqs.question: Are you comfortable building on challenging terrain (e.g. rock)?
faqs.answer: Yes — we have experience building on all types of terrain, including rock and challenging lots. It's what sets Timberline apart from the competition.

faqs.question: How soon can you build?
faqs.answer: Physical building can typically begin within a month of drawings and permit completion, depending on the season and weather.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a Timberline home?
faqs.answer: Once your custom design is complete, you can expect the build to take 4 months to 1 year, depending on the size, detail, and weather conditions of your project. Your final finishing decisions throughout the build also affect the timeline.
